howThisWorks: The dates below are the lead times for the week that starts on anchorWeek. Every Monday after that, the banner moves each one forward 7 days by itself. To reset the pattern, set anchorWeek to this week's Monday and enter this week's dates. To change one week only, add a line to overrides.
